# Oportun to Present at Stephens NASH2026 Annual Investor Conference


November 12, 2026 4:05pm EST[Download as PDF](https://investor.oportun.com/_assets/_a3590ff08eb7f1050a6ff14ac89092b6/oportun/news/2026-11-12_Oportun_to_Present_at_Stephens_NASH2026_Annual_208.pdf)


SAN MATEO, Calif., Nov. 12, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT), a mission-driven financial services company, today announced that it will participate in the upcoming Stephens NASH2026 Annual Investor Conference.


Oportun’s Chief Financial Officer, Bill Franklin, will participate in a fireside chat and in investor meetings at the conference. The fireside chat will begin at 8:00 am CT / 9:00 am ET on November 17th and can be accessed live at this[link](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=3yTTCGSxybAC7BtZqNpR04QJzJf7ZbDzZuHeFSXRmE9p9SBxpk1zsAw5bBrv4HJDyF_aMS0m0NNTpkMwt34BCmMczNAiO6choshUL_SrsDSJgXn54OEfm-Ol8dUUBFrr0Di5KImoS9WSgXpEthK8jRHGMADIPAANnOQk982uuG3_sBilIUKFaDeQus-D7cm3) .


A link to the presentation webcast will also be accessible in the “IR calendar” section of Oportun’s Investor Relations website under “News & Events” at[https://investor.oportun.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=NTIwKiLaoc42meuOZnQtK3rynxTERx2NF1xB9mE_LjvVf84CgO5WDIyC9Npah6FPtg0fptW5XbRDKCJCF1cPVNOSBc2QUPi9e6L6DHwFJfXfX_2yJopQYSle3izZocRVjFfQm_JROnRqlWZ-gPhxEooWUlJ-53YK5cuxjqLqgdDgipQMHux7ZBPiUUBn2gSWDNII3VHGooLcTuEdD37iug2txi-dr9w2YojwHE3jECBn45rN9vV1O4l_GiZ2FpYUsw19VpZHsc9QyJubIxM1ig==) . A replay will be available for an additional 90 days via the same link following the conference.


**About Oportun**
Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $23.3 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually. For more information, visit[Oportun.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=j-sqGc2WH3E704Pd1x0oxrczBRReH2oWolw_4VXqa_vjrN3mJLOqBSTT6SqvzD7LebYagBd2vYeN3CvOo1DxKg==) .
